commitments.text: POST /triage/submit accepts a JSON body with description:string, species:string, and optional temperature:number.
commitments.rationale: This is the normalized REST form of the VetNet request payload used by the Android client.

commitments.text: POST /triage/submit is synchronous: the request blocks until the backend triage engine returns the final diagnosis payload or fails.
commitments.rationale: The original app waits on one OkHttp callback and has no async acceptance handshake.

commitments.text: A successful 200 response contains risk_level, suspected_conditions[], rationale, and next_steps for one completed triage decision.
commitments.rationale: Matches the DiagnosisResponse fields shown in the UI.

commitments.text: The client must not commit a local diagnosis record until a successful response from POST /triage/submit has been parsed.
commitments.rationale: HistoryRecord and VitalRecord are written only after onSuccess.

commitments.text: Network timeout or transport failure is terminal for that triage attempt and returns no authoritative diagnosis payload.
commitments.rationale: The mobile client surfaces an error and leaves the triage unresolved.

commitments.text: The interface exposes no offline submission endpoint, no deferred upload token, and no queue handshake for later replay.
commitments.rationale: v1 is online-first and strong-sync only.

commitments.text: The contract exposes no conflict metadata such as version vectors, last-writer markers, or server change tokens.
commitments.rationale: There is no protocol for reconciling concurrent clinic updates in v1.

commitments.text: On success the client stores a history summary with date, symptoms, riskLevel, and condition, and may also append one temperature vital locally.
commitments.rationale: This mirrors the Room insert behavior after diagnosis success.

commitments.text: On failure the client may display an error toast, but it must not create a pending report, partial triage record, or synthetic diagnosis.
commitments.rationale: v1 errors are terminal and no offline artifact is created.

commitments.text: The interface contract assumes one backend authority for each triage decision and does not define reconciliation between clinic replicas.
commitments.rationale: This keeps the seed faithful to the original single-backend design.

metadata.notes: Synchronous REST contract translated from the original VetNet call path. This seed intentionally captures the strong-sync baseline before offline-first redesign.
